dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Oh, did the wondrous fragrance of my cooked meat draw another? Hehehe.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: You can really tell it's the holidays when the streets are full in this little town. Even outlanders have come to visit.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: I thought he was here to ask for directions, but instead he surprised me when he inquired if I knew how to make any dishes using Philanemo Mushrooms.

dialogues.speaker: Brook
dialogues.text: Cooking with Philanemo Mushrooms... isn't impossible. But at most, they just accent the meat.
